item.title: Ohio orders 10 prediction market operators to stop sports contracts — Oct 14, 2026 · 2:00 PM ET
item.description: - **Ohio orders 10 prediction market operators to stop sports contracts** — The Ohio Casino Control Commission told Polymarket, Robinhood, Coinbase and seven other platforms to stop offering sports event contracts to Ohioans and confirm in writing within 14 days. The letters dated October 2 rely on the Sixth Circuit ruling that sports event contracts are subject to Ohio gambling law. ([iGaming Times](https://igaming-times.com/news/prediction-markets/ohio-orders-10-prediction-markets-to-stop-sports-contracts-a-week-after-its-sixth-circuit-win))

item.title: Kalshi traders flip to October Fed hold at 65 percent after PCE report — Oct 14, 2026 · 2:00 PM ET
item.description: - **Kalshi traders flip to October Fed hold at 65 percent after PCE report** — Kalshi traders gave the Federal Reserve a 65 percent chance of holding rates steady at its October 27 to 28 meeting and a 33 percent chance of a 25 basis point hike. item.title: CFTC moves to rewrite swap rules to cover prediction market event contracts — Oct 14, 2026 · 1:45 PM ET
item.description: - **CFTC moves to rewrite swap rules to cover prediction market event contracts** — The CFTC has proposed rules that would codify sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts as federally regulated swaps, while carving conventional casino-style gambling products out of that definition. The agency says the change would clarify that event contracts fall within its exclusive jurisdiction under the Commodity Exchange Act. ([CoinSpectator](https://coinspectator.com/mainstream/2026/10/10/why-the-cftc-is-rewriting-swap-rules-for-prediction-markets-and-how-it-shifts-the-balance-of-power/))

The agency says the change would clarify that event contracts fall within its exclusive jurisdiction under the Commodity Exchange Act. ([CoinSpectator](https://coinspectator.com/mainstream/2026/10/10/why-the-cftc-is-rewriting-swap-rules-for-prediction-markets-and-how-it-shifts-the-balance-of-power/))

item.title: House Oversight expands insider trading probe to PredictIt, Crypto.com and Hyperliquid — Oct 14, 2026 · 1:45 PM ET
item.description: - **House Oversight expands insider trading probe to PredictIt, Crypto.com and Hyperliquid** — House Oversight Chairman James Comer expanded a congressional insider trading probe by sending letters to Hyperliquid Labs, Crypto.com and Aristotle, the operator of PredictIt. The letters request records on user verification, geographic restrictions and procedures for flagging suspicious trades tied to Fed decisions, elections and geopolitical contracts. ([CryptoRank](https://cryptorank.io/news/feed/66312-house-oversight-hyperliquid-insider-trading-probe))

item.description: - **Four tribal nations launch prediction market apps on Kalshi infrastructure** — Four Native American tribes in California and Oklahoma have launched prediction market apps routed through Kalshi, which handles trade execution. item.description: - **Polymarket perpetual futures expand to 67 contracts across crypto, stocks and commodities** — Polymarket's perpetual futures product, Polymarket Perps, expanded to 67 live contracts covering cryptocurrencies, individual stocks, indexes and commodities such as gold, silver and crude oil. item.title: CME Group launches first baseball futures tied to team performance indexes — Oct 14, 2026 · 1:30 PM ET
item.description: - **CME Group launches first baseball futures tied to team performance indexes** — CME Group launched the first baseball futures on October 12, pending regulatory review, with contracts tracking its FutureSports Performance Indexes for all 30 MLB teams. Trading begins with the four League Championship Series clubs, in standard contracts valued at 10 times the index and micro contracts at one tenth that size. item.description: - **Manifold market puts Chinese lab overtaking U.S. AI frontier odds at 93 percent** — A Manifold market on whether a Chinese lab has overtaken the U.S.-dominated AI frontier on a major leaderboard traded at about 93 percent as of October 11, with roughly 52 percent of its all-time volume arriving in 24 hours. item.title: Polymarket bank-failure bets draw UK scrutiny over market integrity risks — Oct 14, 2026 · 1:30 PM ET
item.description: - **Polymarket bank-failure bets draw UK scrutiny over market integrity risks** — Bets on Polymarket's offshore platform on whether major global banks will fail have drawn scrutiny in the United Kingdom, where the Financial Conduct Authority has said the financial prediction products it examined function similarly to binary options, banned for British retail consumers since 2019. The FCA is discussing prediction markets with overseas regulators and the Bank of England is also monitoring developments. ([Casino.org](https://www.casino.org/news/polymarket-bank-failure-bets-spark-fears-of-self-fulfilling-bank-runs/))

item.title: Robinhood prediction markets generate 156 million dollars in second-quarter revenue, passing crypto — Oct 14, 2026 · 1:30 PM ET
item.description: - **Robinhood prediction markets generate 156 million dollars in second-quarter revenue, passing crypto** — Robinhood's event contracts generated about 156 million dollars of revenue in the quarter ended June 30, more than ten times the year-earlier figure and ahead of crypto transaction revenue of about 100 million dollars. Customers traded a record 13.6 billion event contracts in the quarter, making prediction markets the company's second-largest source of transaction-based revenue behind options. ([Bookmakers Review](https://www.bookmakersreview.com/industry/robinhood-prediction-markets-surpass-crypto-trading-revenue-in-q2/))

item.title: CFTC proposes classifying prediction market event contracts as swaps while excluding sportsbook wagers — Oct 14, 2026 · 1:00 PM ET
item.description: - **CFTC proposes classifying prediction market event contracts as swaps while excluding sportsbook wagers** — The CFTC has proposed a rule defining event contracts on sports, politics, culture and weather as swaps under the Commodity Exchange Act, paired with an interim rule excluding casino games and traditional sportsbook wagers from that definition. Both actions are subject to a 30-day public comment period. item.description: - **NFL tells Supreme Court sports prediction contracts are gambling, not swaps** — The NFL filed an amicus brief urging the Supreme Court to hear New Jersey's case against Kalshi, arguing that sports contracts on prediction markets are gambling rather than CFTC-regulated swaps. item.title: Polymarket whale loses about 147,000 dollars on Eagles bet after last-second Jaguars field goal — Oct 14, 2026 · 12:15 PM ET
